source_issue.title: PLIP: Start separating Blicca (Classic UI) code from the core

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue involves a proposal (PLIP) to gradually separate Classic UI code from the core Plone package. The goal is to clean up the codebase, making it easier to maintain and reducing the overall weight for users of the Volto frontend.

## What needs to be done
- Move Classic UI templates and views into a new package called `plone.classicui` while keeping the core API intact.
- Shift relevant code to `plone.app.layout` but maintain backward compatibility, especially for existing templates.
- Discuss and finalize the structure for Plone 6.x and how it will transition to 7.x without breaking functionality.

## Helpful background
The discussion includes several viewpoints on whether certain templates should remain in `plone.classicui` or be moved to `plone.app.layout`. There are ongoing conversations about managing dependencies and ensuring compatibility across versions.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the existing templates and their purposes.
2. If you're comfortable, start contributing to the cleanup discussions or move specific templates/code as needed.
3. Ensure proper testing for any changes made and consider documenting your work for future contributors.
```
